newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Agrium debt, commercial paper.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Agrium debt, commercial paper.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service on Tuesday said it confirmed the ratings of Agrium Inc's senior debt at A (low) and commerical paper at R-1 (low).
DBRS said the trend on both the debt and commercial paper was stable.
The debt rating agency said the rating was removed from "under review" where it was placed on October 21.
The confirmation followed the approval of the proposed merger of Agrium with Viridian Inc.

DBRS noted that Agrium offered to buy (refinance) Viridian's C$400 million of outstanding debt, which it would assume through the merger. DBRS said that as a result, net debt, post merger, might increase to almost 50 percent of capitalization.
But DBRS said free cash flow should reduce net debt by year end 1997 as the North Amercian farm market was expected to remain strong.
